column1: comment
The hybrid work policy has genuinely improved my work-life balance. I am more productive at home.
Managers are giving feedback inconsistently across teams. Some people get monthly 1-on-1s, others none.
The new health benefits package is a meaningful upgrade. It shows the company cares.
Promotions seem to be based on visibility rather than results. That is demoralizing.
The engineering culture here is strong. I learn from my colleagues every week.
The all-hands meetings feel scripted and do not allow real questions from employees.
Our team lead gives clear direction and shields us from unnecessary organizational noise.
The expense reimbursement process takes over 6 weeks. That is too long for out-of-pocket costs.
The learning budget is genuinely useful and I have completed two certifications this year.
Headcount cuts created a lot of uncertainty and the communication around it was poor.
The office environment is pleasant and the equipment provided is up to date.
Cross-functional collaboration is difficult because teams operate in silos.
I feel respected and trusted to manage my own time. That means a lot.
Salary has not kept pace with inflation. Two years without a real raise is noticeable.
The onboarding program was thorough and I felt prepared by the end of my first month.
Middle management layers slow down decision making significantly.
The hackathon last quarter was a great opportunity to work with people across the company.
Parking at the office is a daily frustration. There are never enough spots.
The mission of this company motivates me. I believe in what we are building.
Performance review criteria are vague and change from cycle to cycle.
Team events have been well-organized and actually fun. Good for morale.
Remote employees feel like second-class citizens in meetings dominated by in-office staff.
The data infrastructure team has done excellent work this year. Deployments are much smoother.
Lack of transparency around company financials creates anxiety, especially after recent news.
I have stayed because of the people. The team I work with is exceptional.
